name: History
blurb: A moment in history, told properly and shown with the real pictures.
detail: Name any historical subject. It reads the history, writes a four-to-five minute narrated documentary for three voices, films it, then finds a real Wikipedia picture for six moments in the script and puts them on screen behind the cast.
reworkExamples: Make it eight minutes instead of five
Use only contemporary paintings, no modern photographs
Add a third character who disagrees with the narrator
